content: यज्ञः [यज्-भावे न] .²1 A sacrifice, sacrificial rite; any offering or oblation; यज्ञेन यज्ञमयजन्त देवाः; तस्माद्यज्ञात् सर्वहुतः <ab>&c.</ab>; यज्ञाद् भवति पर्जन्यो यज्ञः कर्मसमुद्भवः <ls>Bg. 3. 14</ls>. .²2 An act of worship, any pious or devotional act. (Every householder, but particularly a Brāhmaṇa, has to perform five such devotional acts every day; their names are:-- भूतयज्ञ, मनुष्ययज्ञ, पितृयज्ञ, देवयज्ञ, and ब्रह्मयज्ञ, which are collectively called the five ‘great sacrifices’; see महायज्ञ, and the five words separately.) .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of Agni. .²4 Of Viṣṇu; ऋषयो यैः पराभाव्य यज्ञध्नान् यज्ञमीजिरे <ls>Bhāg. 3. 22. 30</ls>.
